info.name: Form Detection
author: pdteam
info.description: A template to detect HTML Forms in page response.

curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'Referer: https://developers.google.com/cloud-messaging/' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Ubuntu; Linux x86_64; rv:52.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/52.0' 'https://firebase.google.com/docs/cloud-messaging'
request:
GET /c2dm/register3 HTTP/1.1
Host: android.apis.google.com
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Ubuntu; Linux x86_64; rv:52.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/52.0
Connection: close
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
Accept-Encoding: gzip
response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Connection: close
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Server: Google Frontend

<!DOCTYPE html><html><body><form action="/subscribe"><input type="text" name="email"><button type="submit">Subscribe</button></form></body></html>
